rationale: PINS the receiver-position claim evidence: a MEMBER call whose receiver chain is PURE (object-of-member only) and rooted at a file IMPORT binding gets metadata.receiverImport = {specifier, binding} plus flat mirrors receiverImportSpecifier/receiverImportBinding. The target stays the member leaf; evidence comes from the file's own imports rows (same evidence the importedBinding claim uses). POSITIVES: default import receiver (path.join), namespace receiver (fs.readFileSync), named import receiver (Route.push), a PURE member chain two levels deep (config.config.rules), require binding receiver (req.join). NEGATIVES must carry NO receiverImport marker: a local class-instance receiver (svc.run), a parameter receiver (thing.run), a CALL-RESULT receiver (path.resolve().customThing() -- receiver is the call result), and a dynamic-specifier require binding (dyn.go -- no literal evidence, never claimable). EXTERNAL-ONLY (Lead decision): relative/absolute/workspace receivers are project-internal and must stay UNMARKED (a claim would launder a resolvable edge); the relative-receiver negative pins that.

expectRelationships.comment: dynamic specifier: no evidence entry, never claimable
